# CANDIDATE: ORB_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A breakout of the opening range accompanied by a volume spike >2x the first‑5‑minute average signals institutional participation and continuation. This captures momentum-driven moves where smart money initiates the day's trend with conviction.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If price exceeds ORB high (long) or low (short) on a 1‑min bar and that bar's volume is ≥2 × average volume of the first 5‑minute bars after market open, enter in the direction of the breakout. Exit shape: Chart-stop at opposite ORB edge, TP1 at 1R, runner trailing at 15% of ATR from extreme. Regime hint: Effective when VIX > 15 and after 09:35‑10:00; avoid low‑volume mornings.
